hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Tip: graphify query available. Use it instead of grep for orientation."}}'   || true ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);fp=str(t.get('file_path') or '').lower().replace(chr(92),'/');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in fp and any(fp.endswith(e) for e in ('.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.py','.go','.rs','.java')) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Reminder: Will you Edit this file? If not, use graphify explain/query instead of reading it."}}'; fi || true
